transient_retry.eligibility: attempt incomplete without evaluator error; every native session complete, not started, or failed with a retained provider HTTP 5xx
transient_retry.what_counts: a cell that needed any rerun is NOT complete and accounted for this gate, whatever its final attempt; every attempt is retained and published with its usage and latency
transient_retry.reporting: cells that needed a rerun, total reruns and first-attempt status counts are published beside the result

pass_rule: pass only if every checker test is true: exact 36-cell matrix, terminal experiment, all 36 final attempts complete and accounted, all 36 cells complete and accounted on the first attempt (no rerun), every attempt within 200,000 tokens, reruns within the declared policy, six aggregate defect-case cells with non-empty mechanically valid v2 evidence, six assessed defect-case cells whose assessor actually ran (usage > 0) and completed with accounting
reference_profile: the gpt-6.1-sol profile that passed schedule r1 (2026-10-13-qualification-rerun) and draws r2, r3 (2026-10-13-tools-reliability-separating): batched context-read prompt (the only persona_inputs.py change from 2f1e95c to 5c4a8b6 appends citation_bound_prompt, which returns an empty string unless context.line_counts is on), 100,000 total ceiling, default assessor reservation (no --assessment-tokens; 20,000), same three pilot development cases, four focused arms, three repetitions, concurrency 3, six native turns, context enabled with the same related paths, rounds.max 3
concurrency_reason_unchanged: vLLM max_num_seqs is 16 in the serving role and 12 concurrent probe streams all returned HTTP 200, so concurrency 3 is not forced down
specialists: not qualified by this schedule: original pilot paths do not activate built-in routing
semantic_quality: provisional; actual human adjudication remains outstanding; zero human judgments
fallback: One schedule (g3), plus at most one re-test only if g3 fails for a diagnosable reason that a documented, prospectively frozen change addresses, with its gate posted on #51 before launch and an explicit maintainer approval. Both published; no post-hoc exclusion. No c2 or re-test is authorized by this task; otherwise stop and report not qualified.
external_spend_rule: only onprem/glm-5.3-flash is called; it has one self-hosted deployment and no router fallback; verify after the run from LiteLLM spend logs that every request in the window on this key was served by openai/glm-5.3-flash at 192.0.2.40:8045 with zero attempted fallbacks
predecessor: c1 (PR #85): 31/36 complete; three citation defects, one repeating stream, one capped assessor misattributed as budget. s2 (PR #81): 34/36.
citation_past_file_end: Citation validation remains authoritative. With citation_correction enabled, a machine-detectable citation defect gets at most one bounded tool-free schema-constrained correction within its session grant. A citation still invalid after correction fails its session and cell (citation_validation or protocol as appropriate), counts against all 36 complete, and is neither excluded nor eligible for a transient rerun. The same applies to malformed revision/content hashes; no relaxed evidence is admitted.
launch_condition: Launch without an idle window, after read-only router/fallback verification and a released-wheel smoke. This is the maintainer's 2026-10-25 instruction to re-qualify with line_counts and citation correction, recorded in #96, applying the 2026-10-22 c1 precedent https://github.com/ViviDynamics/scrutare/issues/51#issuecomment-6340502541. on-prem host carries opencode, python-httpx, client-a and client-b traffic outside this evaluator's control. Record load for the preceding hour, every 15 minutes throughout the systemd service, and re-read the entire run window after exit. Split by user agent, key and base URL; redact personal aliases in public artifacts. In-flight requests and clients bypassing LiteLLM are invisible until logged or entirely invisible.
schedules_allowed: One schedule (g3), plus at most one re-test only if g3 fails for a diagnosable reason that a documented, prospectively frozen change addresses, with its gate posted on #51 before launch and an explicit maintainer approval. Both published; no post-hoc exclusion. No c2 or re-test is authorized by this task; otherwise stop and report not qualified.
